GOVERNMENT"

inauguration of the "Reformed Government." A large
quantity of handbills was distributed by Japanese planes
over the foreign controlled areas. These handbills
eulogized the administration, stating that the government
has already won the confidence and support of both the
Chinese people and foreigners.
The Japanese planes have absolutely no right
to fly over the Foreign Settlements nor have they the
right to distribute pamphlets in these areas for the
"Reformed Government" has not yet been recognized by the
public.

on Hungjao Road, in which a Chinese peasant was shot
dead and another was wounded by a Japanese plain-clothes
search party. The Japanese have no right to conduct
searches at that place. It is said that the two peasants
were fired at because they attempted to flee when they
noticed the Japanese plain-clothes search party.

“维新政府”成立周年纪念日

昨日是“维新政府”成立一周年纪念日。大量传单由日本飞机投撒于外人管辖区域。这些传单颂扬该政权，声称政府已赢得中国人民及外人的信任与支持。
日本飞机绝对无权飞越外国租界，亦无权在这些区域为尚未获得公众认可的“维新政府”散发宣传品。

档案

昨日在虹桥路发生了一起骇人听闻的事件，一名中国农民被日本便衣搜查队枪杀，另一名受伤。日本人无权在该地进行搜查。据说，这两名农民因注意到日本便衣搜查队并试图逃跑而遭到射击。
杨树浦某日本人遇袭身亡一事令人遗憾。虽然我们反对一切恐怖主义行为，但我们认为，在目前形势下，日本的政策是一种挑衅，极易引发摩擦。

One murder and one alleged clash
between Japanese plainclothes men
and guerillas featured the celebra-
tion in this area of the first an-
niversary of the "Reformed Gov-
ernment."
The murder was committed at
7.30 a.m. yesterday when unknown
gunmen shot down and killed Alaru
Makino, 36, Japanese assistant chief
of the Chinese personnel section of
the Shanghai Cotton Spinning and
Weaving Company.
This happened on Pingliang Road
near the Japanese Eastern District
Primary School in the Yangtzepoo
District. Makino was riding in a
ricsha at the time of the shooting.
He was wounded in the head and
died on the way to the infirmary
maintained by the cotton firm.

Suspects Arrested
Members of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party and the Japanese
Gendarmerie immediately threw a
cordon around the area. After some
searching, one cartridge shell was
found. It provided the only
tangible clue that has been dis-
covered since the shooting occurred.
A Japanese naval spokesman at
the regular evening press con-
ference last night informed news-
men that several Chinese suspects
were taken into custody during the
day yesterday and questioned. All
were released except one, he added.
This individual, a Chinese man, is
being held for further interroga-
tion, according to the spokesman.
The murdered man, who was a
native of Fukuoka Prefecture, had
resided in Shanghai for several
years and was a member of the
Japanese Residents' Corporation.

Police Investigating
Detectives of the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Police last night were con-
tinuing their investigation of the
Makino murder and had also ques-
tioned a number of individuals who
were in the area at the time of
the shooting.
The incident described by the
Japanese spokesman as a clash be-
tween Japanese plainclothes men
and "bandits" occurred on Hungjao
Road near Warren Road about 11.30
a.m. yesterday. One Chinese was
killed while another is said to have
been captured.

事发地点位于杨树浦区日本东区小学附近的平凉路。枪击发生时，牧野正乘坐人力车。他头部中弹，在送往该棉纺厂设立的医务室途中死亡。

嫌疑人被捕

日本海军陆战队队员和日本宪兵立即对该区域实施了封锁。经过一番搜索，发现了一枚弹壳。这是自枪击发生以来发现的唯一实质性线索。
日本海军发言人在昨晚的例行记者招待会上告知新闻界人士，昨日白天有几名中国嫌疑人被拘留并接受讯问。他补充说，除一人外，其余均已被释放。据该发言人称，这名中国男子正被扣留以作进一步审讯。
死者系福冈县人，在上海居住数年，是日本居留民团团员。

警方正在调查

上海公共租界工部局警务处侦探昨晚继续调查牧野被杀案，并讯问了枪击发生时在该区域的多名人员。
日本发言人描述为日本便衣人员与“匪徒”之间冲突的事件，发生于昨日上午11时30分左右，地点在虹桥路靠近华伦路（Warren Road）处。一名中国人被打死，另据称有一人被捕。

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY
MAR 29 1939

A Bad Anniversary
YESTERDAY, first anniversary of the formation of the so-called "reformed government", witnessed a number of illegal or improper activities thoroughly in harmony with the spirit of that regime.
One item of interest was the action of a Japanese airplane in flying over the French Concession and International Settlement and dropping pamphlets in Chinese, extolling the Nanking government and asserting—without the slightest substantiation that we can discover—that it enjoys confidence and popularity among both Chinese and foreigners. The airplane had no business over the foreign areas; it had no business dumping propaganda over the foreign areas, and the "reformed government" enjoys neither confidence nor popularity among either Chinese or foreigners. We trust that we make ourselves clear.
Again there was the outrageous affair out Hungjao Road when a plain-clothes Japanese searching party, which had no justification for its presence on that extra-Settlement highway, killed a Chinese farmer and wounded another because they retreated in fear at sight of a group they rightly feared might prove dangerous.
We regret the killing of a Japanese civilian in Yangtzepoo at the hands of an unidentified Chinese. Acts of terrorism cannot be condoned. But neither can it be ignored that the whole policy and presence of the Japanese under current conditions is one stupendous act of provocation bound to lead to endless friction of one sort and another until finally a decent settlement is somehow arrived at.

（批：30/3）

1939年3月29日

糟糕的周年纪念日

昨日，即所谓“维新政府”成立一周年纪念日，见证了许多与该政权精神完全契合的非法或不当活动。
值得关注的一件事是，一架日本飞机飞越法租界和国际公共租界，投撒中文传单，吹捧南京政府，并毫无根据地声称——我们未发现任何证据支持这一说法——它在华人和外人中都享有信任和声望。该飞机无权飞越外人区域；无权在外人区域上空抛撒宣传品；而“维新政府”在华人和外人中既不享有信任，也不拥有声望。希望我们要表达的意思清楚明了。
此外，还有发生在虹桥路的骇人听闻事件，一支没有任何理由出现在这条租界外公路上的日本便衣搜查队，杀害了一名中国农民并致伤另一名，原因仅仅是他们因恐惧而退却，因为他们有理由担心眼前这群人可能带来危险。
我们对一名日本平民在杨树浦被身份不明的中国人杀害表示遗憾。恐怖主义行为不能姑息。但也不能忽视的是，在当前条件下，日本的整个政策和存在本身就是一个巨大的挑衅行为，注定会导致各种各样无尽的摩擦，直到最终以某种方式达成体面的解决为止。

（批注：3/30）
（批注：JCSB.）
（批注：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 3/30.）

CHINA PRESS.
MAR 29 1939

（印：SPECIAL POLICE S. E. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. ____）

5-Barred Flag
Appears Over
Homes, Stores

Japanese Flag Hoisted
Over Broadway
Mansions

LEAFLETS DROPPED
OVER BUND AREA

'Reformed Government'
Activities During
Year Outlined

Yesterday was a big day for manufacturers and dealers in five-barred flags operating in Hongkew and other areas of the International Settlement north of Garden Bridge. This was the day they counted the profits and according to all information available last night, the profits were large.

The occasion was the first anniversary of the inauguration of the "Reformed Government." The day was featured by considerable flag-waving on the part of the residents of the zone as well as the distribution, by airplane, of propaganda leaflets over the Bund and the central district south of Soochow Creek.

Police Precautions

While the propaganda leaflets distributed yesterday stressed the work that the "Ministry of Pacification" was doing in enforcing law and order, precautions against terrorist outbreaks were taken both inside and outside the Settlement.

Reports sifting into the Settlement from the western district stated that extra Japanese patrols were to be seen in that zone, apparently on the lookout for guerillas. Inside the Settlement, the Shanghai Municipal Police took special precautionary measures. Additional search parties patrolled the streets on the constant lookout for suspicious characters and to prevent any wild outbreak of terrorism.

In Hongkew, Japanese patrols were doubled and in some cases even trebled. Extensive searches of vehicles and pedestrians were carried out during the day. These searches were being continued at a late hour last night.

12,000 Flags

No less than 12,000 five-barred flags were raised in front of shops and dwellings in Hongkew and areas of the Eastern District, according to reports appearing in the Japanese daily press.

According to these reports the "Chinese Young Men's Association," an organization said to be devoted to the interests of the "Reformed Government," did all this flag-waving. They also distributed five-barred flags to residents of the area. In some cases house canvassers went around to the celebration. In many instances, however, residents were required to pay for the flags.

（手写批注：29/3 File 29/3）

《字林西报》。
1939年3月29日

（印：特别警察 S. E. 登记号 S. B. D. ____）

五色旗出现
于住宅和商店
上方

百老汇大厦
升起日本国旗

传单投撒于
外滩区域

概述“维新政府”
年度活动

昨日对于在虹口及花园桥以北国际公共租界其他区域经营五色旗的制造商和经销商来说是个大日子。这是他们计算利润的日子，根据昨晚掌握的所有信息，利润丰厚。

适逢“维新政府”成立一周年纪念日。这一天的特点是该区域居民大量挥舞旗帜，以及飞机在苏州河以南的外滩和中心区上空投撒宣传传单。

警方预防措施

虽然昨日投撒的宣传传单强调“绥靖部”在维持治安方面所做的工作，但在租界内外都采取了预防恐怖主义爆发的措施。

从西区传入租界的报告称，在该区域可以看到额外的日本巡逻队，显然是在搜寻游击队。在租界内部，上海公共租界工部局警务处采取了特别的预防措施。增派的搜查队在街道上巡逻，不断留意可疑人物，以防止任何疯狂的恐怖主义爆发。

在虹口，日本巡逻队数量增加了一倍，在某些情况下甚至增加了两倍。白天对车辆和行人进行了广泛的搜查。直到昨晚深夜，这些搜查仍在继续。

12,000面旗帜

据日本日报报道，在虹口和东区部分地区，商店和住宅前升起了不少于12,000面五色旗。

据这些报道，“中华青年协会”（一个据称致力于“维新政府”利益的组织）进行了所有这些挥旗活动。他们还向该地区居民分发五色旗。在某些情况下，上门推销员四处走动进行庆祝。然而，在许多情况下，居民被要求自费购买旗帜。

（手写批注：3/29 归档 3/29）

03353

Lecture On East Asia

Another feature of the program, according to the Japanese report, was a flag-raising ceremony followed by a lecture on East Asia "development". This happened in the auditorium of the "Young Men's Association" on Wing Feng Fang near North Szechuen Road.
Five-barred flags also were distributed by the Japanese Residents' Corporation to Japanese householders in the Hongkew District. Japanese press reports also state.
One of the most interesting phases of yesterday's flag-waving in Hongkew is the fact that the Rising Sun banner, flanked by the five-barred flag, went up over the Broadway Mansions, recently purchased from the Shanghai Land Investment Company by a Japanese concern, the Shanghai Real Estate Company. These two flags replaced the Union Jack.

Ceremony On Building

In a ceremony atop the 16-story structure, the Union Jack, which had flown over Broadway Mansions ever since the place was built, was removed to the strains of "God Save the King," while the Rising Sun and five-barred banners were raised to the tune of Kimigayo, the Japanese national anthem.
A reception was later held in the lounge of the hotel and Chen Shao-keui, a director of the purchasing concern, gave a short resume of the circumstances leading to the change of ownership. A champagne toast was subsequently drunk to Japan, Great Britain and the "Reformed Government."
The distribution of propaganda leaflets over the Bund and the Central District was carried out from an airplane. This was about 9.30 a.m. The plane released leaflets by the bundles, thereby causing a bit of a flurry on the Bund.

Activities Outlined

The leaflets outlined the activities of the "Reformed Government." Among other things, the authors of the leaflet claimed that the "Reformed Government" has spent $8,000,000 on relief during the year of its existence, that it has launched projects for the reconstruction of towns and cities, that it has "helped in the exploitation of mineral resources, the development of the nation's industries and the reconstruction of agricultural areas."
Some attention was given to praising the activities of the "Ministry of Foreign Affairs." "The Ministry" has established "an enviable record," said the leaflet. Among other things, it was pointed out that the "ministry" had sent representatives abroad and had conducted negotiations with the belligerent officials regarding various activities.
The other "departments" of the Reformed Government were given similar praise. These included the "Ministry of Communications" and the "Ministry of Pacification."

03353

东亚讲座

据日本方面的报道，活动的另一个特色是升旗仪式，随后举行关于东亚“发展”的讲座。这发生在北四川路附近永丰坊（Wing Feng Fang，音译）“青年协会”的礼堂内。
据日本媒体报道，日本居留民团还向虹口区的日本住户分发了五色旗。
昨日虹口挥旗活动中最有趣的阶段之一是，旭日旗两侧伴有五色旗，在百老汇大厦上空升起。该大厦最近被一家日本公司——上海房地产公司从上海地产投资公司购得。这两面旗帜取代了英国米字旗。

大楼上的仪式

在这座16层建筑的顶部举行的仪式上，伴随着《上帝保佑国王》的乐曲，自该建筑建成以来一直飘扬在百老汇大厦上空的英国米字旗被降下，而旭日旗和五色旗则伴随着日本国歌《君之代》的曲调升起。
随后在酒店休息室举行了招待会，购买方的董事陈少奎（Chen Shao-keui，音译）简要回顾了导致所有权变更的情况。随后举杯香槟，为日本、英国和“维新政府”祝酒。
在外滩和中心区上空投撒宣传传单是由一架飞机执行的。时间约为上午9时30分。飞机成捆地释放传单，从而在外滩引起了一阵小小的骚动。

活动概述

传单概述了“维新政府”的活动。除其他事项外，传单作者声称，“维新政府”在其存在的一年中花费了800万美元用于救济，启动了城镇重建项目，“帮助开发矿产资源、发展国家工业和重建农业地区”。
传单还着重赞扬了“外交部”的活动。“该部”建立了“令人羡慕的记录”，传单称。其中指出，“该部”已向国外派遣代表，并与交战各方官员就各种活动进行了谈判。
“维新政府”的其他“部门”也受到了类似的赞扬。其中包括“交通部”和“绥靖部”。

1939年3月29日

日本飞机
散发传单

赞扬
“维新政府”之成就

昨日（28日）上午8时30分至9时30分之间，一架日本海军飞机在租界各区上空飞行近一小时，抛撒了赞扬“维新政府”成立一年来成就的传单。中国行人被这阵五颜六色的传单雨所吸引，在传单即将落至人行道时疯狂争抢，但真正阅读的人寥寥无几；例如在南京路和爱德华七世大道（今延安东路），可以看到几群中国人，主要是苦力阶层，聚在一起，由其中一人高声朗读传单内容。
该飞机飞行高度极低，主要集中在市中心区域，尽管至少有一次飞越了静安寺路（今南京西路）直至圣乔治堂（St. Georges）一带。在卸完全部宣传品后，飞机向杨树浦方向消失。

MAR 29 1939

Hongkew Bedecked With Flags
Of Reformed Government

Thousands of five-barred flags bedecked the streets of Hongkew yesterday in commemoration of the first anniversary of the establishment of the Reformed Government following the distribution of more than 12,000 ensigns by the Chinese Young Men's Association, the Shanghai "Mainichi" reported yesterday.

Leading members of the Young Men's Association grouped themselves into 10 parties, and made a house-to-house canvass in Hongkew, Civic Centre, Yangtzepoo, and Chapel, to sell the Reformed Government flags at one dollar each, the daily stated.

A flag-raising ceremony and a lecture on East Asia development were to be held in the auditorium of the association on Wing Feng Fang and North Szechuen Roads, the paper said.

Five-barred flags were also distributed by the Japanese Residents' Corporation, especially to Japanese households in the Hongkew district, according to the "Tairiku Shimpo," another local Japanese daily.

Leaflets From Plane

Part of the day's celebrations locally consisted of flights by a Japanese aeroplane over the city during which thousands of leaflets calling attention to the work performed by the Reformed Government, were distributed. These leaflets fluttered over the city and finally descended to be picked up by Chinese and read.

The leaflets described relief work undertaken and carried out by the Reformed Government, stressing the fact that $2,000,000 had been disbursed in this connection during the past year. Other items touched upon referred to the work of the different ministries of the Nanking government.

新的中华中央政府计划
稳步进展

一周年声明回顾南京政权过去一年的成就；
梁鸿志的四点纲领

日本总司令赞扬
南京当局的工作

南京，3月28日电——维新政府官员今日在一份回顾南京政权过去一年成就的一周年声明中宣布，组建中华中央政府的计划正在迅速推进。

声明称，新中央政府的基本原则已经确定。声明宣称，与日本密切合作对于维持和平秩序以及实施中国的工农业复兴至关重要。

声明回顾称，维新政府于1938年10月1日开始在华中运作，行政院长梁鸿志先生及其他官员在南京就任各职。

声明称，在过去一年中，在日本政府的协助下，南京行政和教育体系在“根除反地方政权”和“清除国民党政权的教学”方面取得了显著进展。为此目的，颁布了临时教育法规，小学复课，编纂并分发教科书，并培训了小学教师。

声明对在恐怖袭击中遇害的几位维新政府官员表示敬意。其中包括被选任为绥靖部长的周凤岐先生、外交部长陈箓先生、杭州市长何燊先生、政府创始人之一李国杰先生等。

声明继续称，在这危险的一年中，梁鸿志和其他官员为实现政府的最终目标——建立东亚新秩序——进行了 vigorous（原文如此，意为大力/积极）的努力。

声明称，正在采取措施加强行政机构，以更有效地执行政府事务。

军事事项

在另一份官方声明中，政府概述了正采取的与日本陆军当局合作的措施。

声明称，在过去一年中，在南京、苏州、杭州和蚌埠设立了四个军区，并在日本陆军的协助下由政府开展了绥靖工作。

声明中还提到了组建海军陆战队的事宜。

四点政策

维新政府行政院长梁鸿志先生今日回顾了政府成立一年来的成就，并概述了旨在争取中国各界合作的四点行政政策。

这位南京官员表示：“维新政府一年前在复杂局势中成立，决心通过事实和指导原则，争取全国各界对政府的认可。”

“在过去一年中，维新政府竭尽全力实现恢复和平秩序、救济难民、稳定农村和复兴商业等方案。”

“为了实现这些行政政策，从政治角度来看，首先必须保护中央政府组织；其次，必须培养个人和整个国家的资源。”

“从经济角度来看，首先，必须通过政府与人民的合作以及促进日中联合行动来实现经济复兴；其次，通过制定有效的政策来复兴工业体系，从而协调农业、工业和其他部门。”——同盟社。

山田中将的声明

日本华中派遣军司令部，3月28日电——日本华中派遣军总司令山田乙三中将在今日的一次媒体采访中表示，维新政府在过去一年中克服的困难堪比“在沙漠中耕作”。

“维新政府于1938年3月28日在战事纷扰中诞生，如今正庆祝其成立一周年，如同凤凰涅槃。值得祝贺的不仅是我本人，还有那些肩负着在东亚建立新秩序这一沉重责任重担的东方民众。”

“幸运的是，新生的华中地区中国人民，认识到其组建由日本、满洲国和中国组成的友好合作体的天授使命，正在**〔此处转录不清〕**维新政府方面取得稳步进展。我们只能希望这项神圣的工作能够取得最圆满的成就。”

“在维新政府成立之时，即南京陷落后不久，可以说华中地区的交通、工业和文化活动几乎处于停滞状态。所有政府职能均陷入停顿，民众处于窒息般的困境中。

"Scorched Earth" Policy
"Due to the pro-Comintern and anti-Japanese Chiang Kai-shek regime, the Chinese masses had nothing to rely upon, no shelter to live in, and no food. Thus, millions of people were cursing the 'scorched earth' policies of the Chiang regime, which thought nothing of sacrificing the welfare of the people. Wandering about in war-scarred areas, their dismal plight could not be ignored.
"Therefore, relief of refugees after the hostilities, and a reorganization of the situation was an extremely urgent necessity which could not be neglected even for a moment. It was only natural that at such a time an overwhelming voice should be raised for the establishment of a new administration among those unhappy people who had lost their leaders.
"It was in response to this wish of the whole of Central China that the Reformed Government was established by such enlightened persons as Mr. Liang Hung-chih and his colleagues. It must be remembered that the Government was thus formed on the foundation of the flesh and blood of Japanese officers and men who were killed in action, and such men as Mr. Chou Feng-chi, Mr. Ho San, and Mr. Chen Lo, who sacrificed themselves for the sake of the new-born Government.

"Cultivation Of Desert"
"Since then the Reformed Government, adhering to its administrative policies of anti-Communism, neighbourly friendship, restoration of peace, and national salvation, has made undaunted efforts to execute its administrative affairs, in co-operation with Japanese forces. Surmounting all difficulties, and devoting itself to the work of restoring order after the hostilities in a manner resembling the cultivation of a desert. The Reformed Government has to-day reached a stage of development in which all its departments are participating.
"The course pursued by the Reformed Government during the past year has bristled with all manner of difficulties. Considering the results so far achieved by the Government, we cannot help but be moved by its exploits.
"Though peace and order have been restored, all kinds of business revived, and the dawn of a new East Asia has been witnessed under the administration of the Reformed Government, yet the military forces of the Kuomintang and Communist elements, boasting that they would win a final victory and dreaming of the effectiveness of a far friend and near enemy policy are disturbing the peace of East Asia, while maintaining a feeble existence in seven interior provinces.

Chiang's Defeats
"Suffering disastrous defeats, the Chiang Kai-shek regime is no match for the Japanese. As we think of the innocent people suffering under the tyrannical Nationalist Government, we keenly feel that we still have a long stretch of our sacred campaign ahead of us.

“焦土”政策
“由于亲共产国际且反日的蒋介石政权，中国民众无所依靠，无栖身之所，亦无粮可食。因此，数百万人咒骂蒋政权不顾人民福祉的‘焦土’政策。他们在战火蹂躏的地区流浪，其悲惨境遇不容忽视。
“因此，战后的难民救济及局势重组是极其紧迫的必要之举，片刻不可懈怠。在此时刻，那些失去领袖的不幸民众中响起压倒性的呼声，要求建立新行政机构，这也是自然而然之事。
“正是为了响应整个华中地区的这一愿望，梁鸿志先生及其同僚等开明人士建立了维新政府。必须铭记，该政府是在阵亡日军官兵的血肉基础之上，以及周凤岐先生、何珊先生和陈洛先生等为新生政府牺牲的人士的基础上建立的。

“荒漠耕耘”
“此后，维新政府坚持反共、睦邻、恢复和平及救国的行政政策，与日军合作，不畏艰难地执行行政事务。克服一切困难，致力于战后秩序恢复工作，其情形犹如在荒漠中耕耘。如今，维新政府各部门均已参与运作，发展至一定阶段。
“过去一年，维新政府所行之路困难重重。鉴于政府迄今取得的成果，我们不禁为其功绩所感动。
“尽管在维新政府的治理下，和平与秩序得以恢复，各类商业复兴，见证了新东亚的黎明，但国民党军队及共产党分子仍盘踞于内地七省，苟延残喘，妄称将取得最终胜利，并梦想着‘远交近攻’策略的有效性，从而扰乱东亚的和平。

蒋介石的失败

A New Order
"The objectives of this campaign
are needless to say, the establish-
ment of a new order in East Asia,

peace for the world; and the for-

the peoples of East Asia, which are

geographical, historical, and cul-

attending the meeting. Following the meeting, the
participants formed a procession and proceeded along Chung
Hwa Road to the West Gate, from where they traversed Zao
Chia Road and dispersed at the Small South Gate at 11 a.m.

Celebration of the First Anniversary of the
Establishment of the Reformed Government.

Work performed by the Reformed
Government during the past year.

- - - -

Since its establishment, the Reformed Government,
which is the administrative centre, has been
endeavouring to establish a foundation for the erection
of a new China through the efforts of its various
Departments which are enforcing the established policies
of the government. The Government has paid two million
dollars for the relief of the refugees at various
places, and has established a relief committee to
undertake relief matters. The government has also
formulated various rules and regulations governing the
duties of its various departments for the purpose of
improving their working efficiency.

The Ministry of Interior

Under the direction of Minister Chen Chung, the
Ministry of Interior has been engaged in readjusting
the administration of home affairs. It has devised
rules and regulations governing (1) the organisation
of hsien and provincial governments, etc., (2) the
punishment of traitors, (3) enforcement of census and
"pao chia" system, and (4) the improvement of police
organs. A number of other rules and regulations have also
been revised. The Ministry has established a Relief
Institution to undertake famine and flood relief work,
an institute for the training of persons to participate
in the administration of hsiens, and a police officers
training institute where more than 400 ambitious youths

庆祝维新政府成立一周年。

维新政府
过去一年的工作。

- - - -

自成立以來，作为行政中心的维新政府一直通过其各部门执行既定政策的努力，致力于为建立新中国奠定基础。政府已拨款二百万元用于各地难民救济，并成立了救济委员会以处理救济事务。政府还制定了各种规章制度，规范各部门职责，以提高工作效率。

内政部

在内政部长陈中的指导下，内政部一直致力于调整内政管理。它制定了 governing (1) 县和省政府等组织的规则条例，(2) 惩治汉奸，(3) 实施户口和“保甲”制度，以及 (4) 改善警察机构。其他一些规章制度也进行了修订。该部设立了救济机构以开展赈灾和防洪工作，设立了培训参与县政管理人员的机构，以及警官培训机构，其中四百多名有志青年

are undergoing rigorous training. In addition the
Ministry is planning the establishment of institutes
for the training of persons in land administration,
district autonomy and statistics, and is also devising
other ways and means to improve the administration of
home affairs.

**Ministry of Foreign Affairs**

This ministry has performed much meritorous work
through numerous difficulties. It has effected the
restoration of custom houses, dispatched diplomatic
representatives abroad, conducted negotiations in
connection with terrorist activities in the Foreign
Settlement in Shanghai, and established informal
diplomatic relations with the various powers with a
certain degree of success. Theorganization of the
ministry has been strengthened and its working efficiency
improved. It is now concentrating its attention on
the making of preparations for the establishment of
regular diplomatic relations between the Reformed
Government and the Foreign Powers.

**Ministry of Finance**

In view of the sufferings of the people through the
war, the Reformed Government is exercising great
prudence in matters relating to taxation. The Ministry
has requested the Reformed Government to exempt the
land tax in Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei. The Ministry
is also rehabilitating cities and towns and collecting
certain taxes to replenish the government chest.
Under the direction of Minister Chen Ching Tao, the
administration of the ministry has taken shape.

正在接受严格训练。此外，该部正计划设立培训机构，以培训土地管理、地方自治和统计方面的人员，并正在 devising（筹划）其他方法和手段以改善内政管理。

**外交部**

该部在重重困难之下完成了许多卓有成效的工作。它实现了海关的恢复，向海外派遣了外交代表，就上海公共租界内的恐怖活动进行了谈判，并与各列强建立了非正式外交关系，取得了一定程度的成功。该部的组织架构得到加强，工作效率得以提高。目前，该部正集中精力为维新政府与列强建立正式外交关系做准备。

**财政部**

鉴于人民因战争而遭受苦难，维新政府在税收事务上极为谨慎。该部已请求维新政府免除江苏、浙江和安徽的地税。该部还在恢复城镇秩序并征收某些税款以充实国库。在部长陈锦涛的指导下，该部的行政管理已初具规模。

**Ministry of Industry**

The Ministry has done much in developing industry
and commerce, rehabilitating villages, promoting forestry
and opening mines, and is now also engaged in other
important work for the benefit of the people. Under
Minister Wang Ta Hai, the Ministry, with the cooperation
of its employees and experts, has been able to attain
much success in its undertakings.

**Ministry of Justice**

Until the judicial system is organized, the Ministry
of Justice is the supreme judicial organ of the Reformed
Government. It has the following departments :-
General Affairs, Criminal Branch, Civil Branch and
Goal Branch. The General Affairs Branch has four
sections while the other branches have two sections each.
As the judicial organs at various places have been
destroyed during the war, the Ministry, under the
direction of its Minister Joe Hui Tai, has been
endeavouring to re-establish the organs and has completed
the necessary preparations.

**Ministry of Communications**

Since Mr. Kong Hang Chih's assumption of office
as Minister of Communications, serious preparations have
been made for the purpose of bringing to completion
every available means of communication. Traffic has
already been resumed along the various railway lines in
the Central China Area and new lines will also be
developed in due course of time. A net work of highways
have been constructed and maintained in the Central China
Areas and at present all traffic is being officially handled
by the Central China Omnibus Company. Rapid
developments have also been made with regard to
tele-communications, postal communications and inland
navigation.

- 3 -

**实业部**

该部在发展工商业、恢复乡村、促进林业和开采矿山方面做了大量工作，目前也致力于其他造福民众的重要工作。在部长王泰来（音译）的领导下，该部在其职员和专家的配合下，各项事业取得了诸多成功。

**司法部**

在司法体系组建完成之前，司法部是维新政府的最高司法机关。它设有以下部门：总务处、刑事处、民事处和监狱处。总务处下设四个科，其他各处各下设两个科。由于各地的司法机关在战争期间遭到破坏，该部在部长周慧泰（音译）的指导下，一直努力重建这些机关，并已完成必要的准备工作。

**交通部**

自孔行智（音译）先生出任交通部部长以来，为完善所有可用的交通手段，已进行了严肃的筹备工作。华中地区的各条铁路线已恢复通车，新线路也将适时开发。华中地区已修建并维护了公路网，目前所有交通事务均由华中汽车公司官方处理。电信、邮政和内河航运方面也取得了迅速进展。

Ministry of Pacification

This Ministry of Pacification is the supreme
military organ of the Reformed Government, which
undertakes the task of maintaining peace and order in
the Central China area and of bringing into being a new
army under the direction and supervision of Mr. Jen Yuan-
tuo, the Minister of Pacification. The majority of the
personnel of this ministry are military experts, whose
duties may be classified as follows :-
(1) Establishment of a military academy for the training
of junior officers of the new army of China;
(2) The suppression and pacification of the remnants of
the Kuomintang armies and bandits in order to ensure
the peaceful condition of the various localities
under the jurisdiction of the Reformed Government,
and the impounding of firearms that may have been
left in the various areas.

Ministry of Education

Substantial achievements have been attained in the
post-war revival of education under the direction and
supervision of the former and the present Ministers of
Education, Messrs. Chen and Kee respectively. A number
of educational programmes have been adopted and are
gradually being put into force; these programmes include
the relief of those students who are unable to continue
their studies due to various reasons, the reorientation
of the educational policy of the Reformed Government,
the revision and promulgation of the various educational
statutes of the various grades of educational institutions,
and the restoration of the different organizations for
the promotion of physical culture for the masses.

**绥靖部**

绥靖部是维新政府的最高军事机关，承担在华中地区维持和平与秩序的任务，并在绥靖部部长任援道先生的指导和监督下组建一支新军。该部人员多为军事专家，其职责可分类如下：
(1) 建立一所军事学院，以培训中国新军的初级军官；
(2) 镇压和肃清国民党军队残部及匪徒，以确保维新政府管辖下各地的和平状况，并收缴散落在各地区的枪支。

**教育部**

在前任和现任教育部长陈先生和季先生（音译）的指导和监督下，战后教育的复兴取得了实质性成就。多项教育方案已被采纳并逐步实施；这些方案包括救济因各种原因无法继续学业的学生，调整维新政府的教育政策，修订和颁布各级教育机构的各项教育法规，以及恢复各种面向大众的体育促进组织。

At about 1 p.m. 28-3-39 about 150 Chinese carrying banners
and (five bar) Chinese flags assembled inside Hongkew Park. They
remained there until about 1.30 p.m. At this time fifteen buses
each carrying approximately thirty passengers arrived from the
Civic Centre but did not enter the Park. They halted a few
moments, threw pro-Reformed Government handbills from the win-
dows of the buses and proceeded on to the Foo Ming Theatre on
North Szechuen Road.

At this time the persons assembled in the Park formed into
a procession and walked down North Szechuen Road into the theat-
re mentioned. In this procession was about 20 uniformed members
of the New China Youth's Association who carried their "house"
banners.

It is understood that speeches were made in the theatre by
prominent members of the Reformed Government including Mayor Fu
Siao An. These celebrations terminated at about 3.50 p.m. The
buses that came from the Civic Centre returned and the remainder
dispersed. All Policing was done by the Shanghai Municipal Police
and no incident occurred.

Aeroplane

Government hand-bills were dropped from an aeroplane over the
Dixwell Road Police area, copies of which with a rough trans-

维新
政府
成立
周年
纪念

1939年3月28日下午1时许，约150名中国人携带横幅和（五色）中国国旗在虹口公园内集合。他们停留至下午1时30分左右。此时，十五辆巴士每辆载有约三十名乘客从市民中心抵达，但未进入公园。它们停留片刻，从车窗抛出支持维新政府的传单，然后继续前往北四川路的福民剧院。

此时，公园内集合的人群组成队伍，沿北四川路步行进入上述剧院。队伍中约有20名身穿制服的新中华青年会成员，他们携带该会的“内部”横幅。

据悉，维新政府的知名成员，包括市长傅筱庵，在剧院发表了演讲。这些庆祝活动于下午3时50分左右结束。从市民中心来的巴士返回，其余人员散去。所有警务工作均由上海公共租界工部局警务处执行，未发生任何事件。

Distribution of Pamphlets from Aeroplane.

At 9.15 a.m. on the 28/3/39, F.S. 96 Turner brought to the station from East Seward Road near Broadway three pamphlets which he had picked up after these had been dropped from a large winged aeroplane bearing a Japanese ensigna on the under structure of each wing.

A perusal of the pamphlets reveal that the contents refer to the 1st. anniversary of the Reformed Government, its activities since the inauguration and its future programme.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Attempt to Force Householders In Chapei, O.O.L.
To Purchase "Five Barred" Flags.

Sir,

At 4.45 p.m. 27/3/1939, F.S.14 Berthel reported that he had observed a male Chinese wearing the uniform of a officer of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai City Government, accompanied by four male Chinese, one of whom was carrying a number of "Five Barred" flags, enter Chinese Dwelling Houses on Thorne Road, opposite Kashing Road Station, which are situated in Chapei, O.O.L., with the object of having the occupants to purchase the flags.

It was subsequently ascertained that the party had endeavoured to sell the flags to the householders at $1.00 each, and threatened them that failure to purchase would result in a report to the Japanese Authorities.

Translation of a handbill copies of which
were dropped from an aeroplane flying over the

Celebration of the First Anniversary of the
establishment of the Reformed Government.

Work performed by the Reformed
Government during the past year.

Since its establishment, the Reformed Government,
which is the administrative centre, has been
endeavouring to establish a foundation for the erection
of a new China through the efforts of its various
departments which are enforcing the established policies
of the government. The Government has paid two million
dollars for the relief of the refugees at various
places, and has established a relief committee to
undertake relief matters. The government has also
formulated various rules and regulations governing the
duties of its various departments for the purpose of
improving their working efficiency.

The Ministry of Interior

Under the direction of Minister Chen Chung, the
Ministry of Interior has been engaged in readjusting
the administration of home affairs. It has devised
rules and regulations governing (1) the organisation
of hsien and provincial governments, etc., (2) the
punishment of traitors, (3) enforcement of census and
"pao chai" system, and (4) the improvement of police
organs. A number of other rules and regulations have also
been revised. The Ministry has established a Relief
Institution to undertake famine and flood relief work,
an institute for the training of persons to participate
in the administration of hsiens, and a police officers
training institute where more than 400 ambitious youths

庆祝维新政府成立一周年。

维新政府过去一年之工作。

自成立以來，作为行政中心的维新政府一直通过其各部门执行既定政策，努力为建设新中国奠定基础。政府已拨付两百万元用于各地难民救济，并设立救济委员会负责救济事务。政府还制定了规范各部门职责的各项规章条例，以提高工作效率。

内政部

在内政部长陈群（Chen Chung）的指导下，内政部一直致力于调整内务行政。该部制定了关于以下事项的规章条例：(1) 县及省政府等的组织，(2) 惩治汉奸，(3) 实施户口调查及“保甲”制度，以及 (4) 改善警察机构。其他多项规章条例也已修订。该部设立了救济机构以承担赈灾和防洪工作，设立了培训人员参与县政管理的研究所，以及警官训练所，其中有四百多名有志青年

pages.en:

are undergoing rigorous training. In addition the
Ministry is planning the establishment of institutes
for the training of persons in land administration,
district autonomy and statistics, and is also devising
other ways and means to improve the administration of
home affairs.

**Ministry of Foreign Affairs**

This ministry has performed much meritorous work
through numerous difficulties. It has effected the
restoration of custom houses, dispatched diplomatic
representatives abroad, conducted negotiations in
connection with terrorist activities in the Foreign
Settlement in Shanghai, and established informal
diplomatic relations with the various powers with a
certain degree of success. The organization of the
ministry has been strengthened and its working efficiency
improved. It is now concentrating its attention on
the making of preparations for the establishment of
regular diplomatic relations between the Reformed
Government and the Foreign Powers.

**Ministry of Finance**

In view of the sufferings of the people through the
war, the Reformed Government is exercising great
prudence in matters relating to taxation. The Ministry
has requested the Reformed Government to collect the
land tax in Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei. The Ministry
is also rehabilitating cities and towns and collecting
certain taxes to replenish the government funds.
Under the direction of Minister Chen Ching-ho, the
administration of the ministry has been improved.

正在接受严格训练。此外，该部正计划设立土地管理、地方自治和统计人员培训机构，并正在 devising 其他改进内务行政的方法与手段。

**外交部**

该部在重重困难下完成了许多卓有成效的工作。它实现了海关的恢复，向海外派遣了外交代表，就上海公共租界内的恐怖活动进行谈判，并与列强建立了非正式外交关系，取得了一定程度的成功。该部的组织架构得到加强，工作效率得以提高。目前正集中精力准备建立维新政府与列强之间的正式外交关系。

**财政部**

鉴于人民因战争遭受苦难，维新政府在税收事务上极为谨慎。该部已请求维新政府在江苏、浙江和安徽征收田赋。该部还在恢复城镇秩序并征收某些税项以补充政府资金。在财政部长陈锦涛（Chen Ching-ho）的指导下，该部的行政管理得到了改善。

**Ministry of Industry**

The Ministry has been much in developing industry
and commerce, rehabilitating villages, promoting forestry
and opening mines, and is now also engaged in other
important work for the benefit of the people. Under
Minister Wang **〔此处转录不清〕** the Ministry, with the co-operation
of its employees and experts, has been able to attain
much success in its undertakings.

**Ministry of Justice**

Until the judicial system is organized, the Ministry
of Justice is the supreme judicial organ of the Reformed
Government. It has the following departments :-
General Affairs, Criminal Branch, Civil Branch and
Local Branch. The General Affairs Branch has four
sections while the other branches have two sections each.
As the judicial organs at various places have been
destroyed during the war, the Ministry, under the
direction of its Minister Sun Fo Tai, has been
endeavouring to re-establish the organs and has completed
the necessary preparations.

**Ministry of Communications**

Since Mr. Wong Hung Chih's assumption of office
as Minister of Communications, serious preparations have
been made for the purpose of bringing to completion
every available means of communication. Traffic has
already been resumed along the various railway lines in
the Central China Area and new lines will also be
developed in due course of time. A net work of highways
have been constructed and maintained in the Central China
Area and at present all traffic is being officially handled
by the Central China Omnibus Company. Rapid
developments have also been made with regard to
tele-communications, postal communications and inland
navigation.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

**实业部**

该部大力致力于发展工商业、恢复乡村、促进林业和开采矿山，目前还从事其他造福民众的重要工作。在部长王 **〔此处转录不清〕** 的领导下，该部在其雇员和专家的合作下，在其各项事业中取得了很大成功。

**司法部**

在司法体系组建完成之前，司法部是维新政府的最高司法机关。它设有以下部门：总务处、刑事处、民事处和地方处。总务处下设四个科，其他各处各设两个科。由于各地的司法机关在战争期间遭到破坏，该部在部长孙佛台（Sun Fo Tai，音译）的指导下，一直努力重建这些机关，并已完成必要的准备工作。

**交通部**

自黄鸿志（Wong Hung Chih，音译）先生出任交通部长以来，为完善所有可用的交通手段进行了严肃的准备。华中地区的各条铁路线已恢复通车，新线路也将适时开发。华中地区已修建并维护了公路网，目前所有交通均由华中汽车公司官方运营。电信、邮政通信和内河航运方面也取得了快速发展。

在前任和现任教育部长陈先生和顾先生（Messrs. Chen and Koo）的指导和监督下，战后教育的复兴取得了实质性成就。已通过多项教育计划并正在逐步实施；这些计划包括救济因各种原因无法继续学业的学生，调整维新政府的教育方针，修订和颁布各级教育机构的各项教育法规，以及恢复各种促进大众体育的组织。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL REGISTRY
No. S. 411. 9109
March 27, 1939.
Date 28 3 39

Headquarters Circular No. 164

Anniversary of the Establishment of
"The Reformed Government" in Nanking, March 28, 1938

In view of the above mentioned anniversary the following
precautionary measures will be taken on March 28, 1939.

1. D.Os. will arrange for intensive search parties from
7.00 a.m. March 28th attention being paid to roof gardens,
cyclists and newsboys with satchels. Posters of a political
nature must be removed at once if seen and special attention
given to this matter.

2. First day patrols will be on their posts by 6.00 a.m.
and night duties report off at 7.00 a.m. March 28th. Bicycle
patrols will be ordered by D.Os. where and when necessary.

3. The Russian Regiment, S.V.C. will supply mobile
patrols which will operate on Foochow - Yu Ya Ching - Peking
Roads and the Bund from 7.00 a.m. March 28th.

4. The British Military, U.S. Marine Corps and Royal
Italian Marines will intensify patrols in their Sectors from
7.00 a.m. March 28th.

5. Special precautions will be taken by D.C. (Crime)
and D.C. (Special Branch).

6. "Stand down" will be circulated by D.C. (Divisions)
as soon as the situation appears to warrant it.

7. The circulation of information immediately is of the
utmost importance and all units and the Special Branch will
give particular attention to this important matter.

〔此处有多处手写签名及批注，难以辨认〕

Commissioner of Police.

特别登记处
编号 S. 411. 9109
1939年3月27日。
日期 28 3 39

总部通令第164号

南京“维新政府”成立周年纪念，1938年3月28日

鉴于上述周年纪念日，将于1939年3月28日采取以下预防措施。

1. 各区督察长（D.Os.）将安排密集搜查队，从3月28日上午7时开始，注意屋顶花园、骑自行车者及携带皮包的小报童。一旦发现政治性质的海报，必须立即清除，并对此事给予特别关注。

2. 早班巡逻队将于3月28日上午6时前到岗，夜班勤务于上午7时下班。各区督察长将在必要的时间和地点下令自行车巡逻队出动。

3. 上海义勇军（S.V.C.）俄国团将提供机动巡逻队，从3月28日上午7时起，在福州路、虞洽卿路、北京路及外滩一带执行任务。

4. 英军、美国海军陆战队和意大利皇家海军陆战队将从3月28日上午7时起加强各自防区的巡逻。

5. 刑事侦缉处长（D.C. (Crime)）和政治部处长（D.C. (Special Branch)）将采取特别预防措施。

6. 一旦局势显示有必要，分区副处长（D.C. (Divisions)）将发布“解除警戒”通知。

7. 立即流通情报至关重要，所有单位和政治部将特别关注这一重要事项。

〔此处有多处手写签名及批注，难以辨认〕

警务处处长。

CHINA PRESS.
S. 03299 RY
No. S. B.

City Prepared
For Trouble On
Puppet Holiday

'Reformed Government'
To Celebrate First
Anniversary Today

Strong patrols will police the streets of the International Settlement today, the first anniversary of the formation of the puppet "Reformed Government". Co-operating with the Shanghai Municipal Police will be the British forces, American and Italian Marines, and the Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

Except for the intensified search parties and patrols which will operate from 7 a.m. today, there will be no other evidence of the anniversary in south-of-the-creek sectors of the Settlement.

S.V.C. Units Assist

The Shanghai Volunteer Corps will be asked to send out mobile units, represented largely by the Russian Regiment and Armored Cars, at 7 a.m. today. The units will remain on duty until ordered to disband by the S.M.P.

While the volunteers will patrol the downtown area girdled by Foochow, Yu Ya Ching and Peking Roads and the Bund, foreign defense forces here will send reinforced detachments to safeguard their respective sectors to prevent any possible outbreak or demonstration.

All police patrols will be increased in strength, and the Special Branch will be on the alert all day.

Hongkew To Rejoice

Demonstrations of rejoicing and an atmosphere of Nippon-manufactured festivity is expected to prevail north of Soochow Creek, where the Japanese Naval Landing Party and army patrols will be largely responsible for the maintenance of peace and order.

“维新政府”
今日庆祝成立
一周年

今天是傀儡“维新政府”成立一周年，国际租界的街道将由强力巡逻队维持治安。与上海公共租界工部局警务处合作的将有英军、美国和意大利海军陆战队，以及上海义勇军。

除了从今天上午7时开始行动的强化搜查队和巡逻队外，在租界苏州河以南区域不会有其他庆祝周年纪念的迹象。

义勇军部队协助

上海义勇军将于今天上午7时派出机动部队，主要由俄国团和装甲车组成。这些部队将一直执勤，直到接到工部局警务处解散的命令。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

MAR 28 1939

Precautionary Measures
Being Enforced Today
No Trouble Expected on
“Ta Tao” Anniversary

Today being the first anniversary
of the “Reformed Government,” the
Shanghai Municipal and Concession
Police forces have taken precau-
tionary measures to prevent any un-
toward incident or terrorist outrages
which may have been planned.
These special measures are being en-
forced from 7 a.m. and will, it is
believed, be cancelled at midnight
although they may be carried on
should there be any reason to fear
other incidents.
Additional search-parties will be
on Settlement streets today in addi-
tion to the regular search parties and
pedestrians as well as vehicles are
likely to be stopped.

1939年3月28日

今日实施
预防措施
预计“大道”周年纪念日
无骚乱

今天是“维新政府”成立一周年，上海公共租界和法租界警察部队已采取预防措施，以防止任何可能发生的不幸事件或恐怖暴行。这些特别措施从上午7时开始实施，据信将在午夜取消，但如果有任何理由担心其他事件，可能会继续执行。

今天租界街道上除了常规搜查队和行人外，还将有额外的搜查队，车辆也可能被拦停。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
MAI 28 1939

FIRST ANNIVERSARY
OF NEW REGIME
Policies Reiterated By
Executive Yuan Head;
Rebuilding Work

The Reformed Government, which
was established March 23 a year
ago, will continue its efforts to re-
store order, improve business, carry
out rural rehabilitation plans and
maintain friendly relations with
Japan, Mr Liang Hung-chu, Pres-
ident of the Executive Yuan, de-
clared in a statement issued yes-
terday in connection with the first
anniversary of the Nanking regime.
In both political and economic
fields the Reformed Government is
making great progress and is work-
ing in close co-operation with
Japan to help establish lasting peace
in East Asia, the statement said.
Mr. Liang urged his countrymen
to pledge their support to the new
Government and to assist in pre-
serving the nation's vitality. The
new regime is ready to accept any
constructive proposals and is doing
everything possible to accomplish
the work of national reconstruction,
the statement said.

Lile

1939年5月28日（原文如此，应为3月）

新政权
第一周年
行政院院长重申政策；
重建工作

一年前的3月23日成立的维新政府，将继续努力恢复秩序、改善商业、执行农村复兴计划并保持与日本的友好关系，行政院院长梁鸿志先生在昨日就南京政权成立一周年发表的声明中宣称。

声明称，维新政府在政治和经济领域都取得了巨大进展，并与日本密切合作，帮助建立东亚的持久和平。

梁先生敦促同胞们宣誓支持新政府，并协助保护国家的元气。声明称，新政权准备接受任何建设性提议，并正在尽一切可能完成国家重建工作。

Lile
